parts.name: report
parts.about: The whole book is read and scored (10 dimensions, strengths and weaknesses with quotes) by the working AIs that did not write it; word counts, the editor's notes and who did what are added; then the “sounds like a person” pass. Never holds up the book (a failure is a REPORT_FAILED note).

parts.name: beta (beta reader)
parts.about: Only with the run setting beta_reader: an AI reads the whole book as its target reader and marks where it got confused, bored or guessed a twist, each quote checked against the book (a panel of 2–3 readers with beta_readers). Never holds up the book.

parts.name: opening (rewrite chapter 1 last)
parts.about: Chapter 1 is reworked once with the whole book in view; the same reviewers re-read the book and the new chapter 1 is kept only if the score is at least as good; a kept chapter goes through the usual review and the book is exported again. Never holds up the book.

parts.name: improve (improve until better)
parts.about: The 3 weakest scenes (from the reviewers, the editor, the beta readers and Akọwe's own checks) are rewritten; the same reviewers re-read the book; the rewrite is kept only if the score went up and nothing dropped, then reviewed, approved and exported again. Never holds up the book.

parts.name: reread (read the final book again)
parts.about: After the end rewrites, the final whole-book continuity check and the beta reader(s) read the book again where it changed; the run window gets the book's length against its target. Never holds up the book.

results.title: the AI times out (once; and every time)
results.happened: Once: The book finished with nothing lost. — Every time: The book finished with nothing lost.
risks: the whole-book review was lost after 1 failed reviewer call(s) of 1 (TIMEOUT): the report is made without any AI review, so the opening and improve passes are skipped too (OPENING_SKIPPED, IMPROVE_SKIPPED)
the step says “no independent AI was working” although the reviewer AI was working and failed (TIMEOUT): the message blames the wrong thing
notes: End state of “report”: done — “⚠️ Report made without an AI review: no independent AI was working (📨 Ask the other AIs on the report page later)” (journal: HUMAN_PASS, REPORT_NOT_INDEPENDENT).

finding.where: akowe/akowe/book_report.py `ReportService.review_with` (line ~718: `job.retry_busy = False`; a failure becomes a `failed` row, lines ~745-757) and akowe/akowe/autobook.py `_s_report` (line ~4569: the “no independent AI was working” text whenever `aggregate.reviewers` is 0); opening_pass.py line ~314 and improve_pass.py line ~337 then skip (NO_REVIEW)
finding.cause: The whole-book reviewer's job is made with `retry_busy=False`, so a timeout / busy / usage-limit answer is not waited for or retried: the reviewer row is `failed` at once (only AI_DECLINED gets a second ask and a stand-in). With no `done` review the report has no scores, `_s_report` says “no independent AI was working” (it never looks at the failed rows), and the opening and improve passes, which need a reviewer score, are skipped.
finding.fix: Let the run's whole-book review use the normal busy / usage-limit wait (retry_busy=True, as the beta reader does) or retry a failed reviewer once; when reviewers failed, say “The reviewer AI could not answer (TIMEOUT) — 📨 Ask the other AIs on the report page” instead of “no independent AI was working”.
finding.what: One timeout of the reviewer AI loses the whole-book review (and with it the opening and improve passes); the step blames “no independent AI was working”

finding.where: akowe/akowe/calibration.py `assess_book` / `judge` (line ~177) and book_report.py `_trust` (line ~852)
finding.cause: The P36 trust check only asks for proof of HIGH scores (a 9/10 needs a quote, a near-perfect average needs quoted weaknesses). A review of 1/10 everywhere with no weakness and no quote passes as trusted; with one reviewer nothing compares it.
finding.fix: Treat a very low average (≤ 3) with fewer than 2 quoted weaknesses as untrusted too (ask again once, then mark it “unbacked”).
finding.what: A 1/10-for-everything review with no quoted weakness is accepted as it is

finding.where: akowe/akowe/beta_reader.py `_early` (line ~256) and `findings` (line ~263); used by improve_pass.`_latest_beta` and opening_pass.`brief` (line ~178-183)
finding.cause: Reactions are counted only when their quote is in the book (`rx = [r for r in reactions if r['verified']]`), but `_early` counts every guess whatever its quote: a guess with an invented or paraphrased quote makes “Twists the reader saw coming” (major when the reveal is ≥ 2 chapters later), and the opening pass is then told to hide a twist in chapter 1.
finding.fix: Count a guess only when its quote is verified (or count unverified guesses as info only, like the reactions), and say how many guesses were left out.

finding.where: akowe/akowe/opening_pass.py `_approve` (line ~411: `if head['version'] == c['version']` — when the author saved a newer version the rewrite is skipped silently, then `_review_until_approved` reviews and approves the HEAD, i.e. the author's draft) and `_finish` (the line still says “kept”)

finding.where: akowe/akowe/final_reads.py `run_step` / `_beta_again` (no `runner.check(run)` after the beta re-read) and the run loop's end in autobook.py
finding.cause: The pause request is only acted on at the next check; the beta re-read is the last AI call of the last step, so the run finishes as done right after “You pressed Pause”.
finding.fix: Call `runner.check(run)` after the re-read (or honour a pending pause before marking the run done).
